script: Spread and total were not saved for Week 5 TB at DAL, so the script is form-only: the Tampa Bay Buccaneers have ridden Bucky Irving (48 carries, 196 rush yards in weeks 2-4) while Baker Mayfield is negative on both splits (-0.18 EPA vs blitz, -0.23 with no blitz), and the Dallas Cowboys have ridden CeeDee Lamb (39 targets, 454 yards) with Dak Prescott positive in both (0.13 vs blitz, 0.32 without). DAL allows 4.93 yards per carry and 15 runs of 10-plus, so TB should keep the ball on the ground with Irving; TB allows 3.58 yards per carry and only 8 runs of 10-plus, so DAL should throw rather than lean on Javonte Williams (50 carries, 190 yards, 3.8 YPC).
who_goes_off: For TB at DAL, Bucky Irving should go off on the ground because he has 48 of Tampa Bay's backfield carries and 196 rush yards versus Jalen Daniels's 9 for 64 and Kenneth Gainwell's 8 for 11, into a Dallas defense that has allowed 4.93 YPC and 15 runs of 10-plus. CeeDee Lamb should go off for the Cowboys through the air: 454 receiving yards and 380 air yards on 39 targets, more than double George Pickens's 197 on 22, against a Buccaneers middle that allows 9.13 yards per attempt.
weak_spot: The Dallas Cowboys' real weak spot versus Tampa Bay is the middle at 11.62 YPA on 24 attempts, versus 8.0 left (42 attempts) and 7.55 right (47), so the matchup is DAL linebackers, nickel, and safeties — Cade Otton's 18 TB targets and 131 yards — not the outside corners. The Tampa Bay Buccaneers' leak versus Dallas is the same band, middle 9.13 YPA on 23 attempts versus 6.2 left (54) and 6.64 right (47), which is where Cowboys target CeeDee Lamb (380 air yards) and Jake Ferguson (13 targets, 77 yards) while both edges have held.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for Week 5 TB at DAL, so there is no Buccaneers or Cowboys fallout to reprice: Tampa Bay's Bucky Irving still owns 48 carries, Dallas's CeeDee Lamb still owns 39 targets, and Dallas's Javonte Williams still owns 50 carries from weeks 2-4.
qb_vs_blitz: Dallas blitzes only 27%, and Tampa Bay's Baker Mayfield is worse without the blitz (-0.23 EPA) than into it (-0.18 on 62 dropbacks), so DAL's light pressure does not fix the TB dropback game and supports staying with Irving. Tampa Bay blitzes 42%, which is Dallas quarterback Dak Prescott's worse split (0.13 EPA on 52 blitzed dropbacks versus 0.32 unblitzed), but he stays positive, so the TB blitz taxes the Cowboys without taking Lamb off a 13-target pace.

picks.why: TB's Bucky Irving is at 65.3 rush yards a game (196 on 48 carries, 4.08 YPC) against a 53 line, and the DAL defense has allowed 4.93 YPC plus 15 runs of 10-plus, so 16 Buccaneers carries at even his own rate clears 53 while Mayfield's -0.23 EPA on non-blitz dropbacks keeps Tampa Bay on the ground against Dallas.

DAL's CeeDee Lamb is at 151.3 receiving yards a game (454 on 39 targets, 380 air yards) against an 84.5 line, and the TB defense allows 9.13 YPA in the middle on 23 attempts while Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott remains positive into Tampa Bay's 42% blitz at 0.13 EPA.
